subject: Third-party penetration test: logistics, credentialing, and deliverables timeline
messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex@redpensecurity.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + initial questions for pen test engagement (scope proposal attached)

Laura / Marcus / Vivek,

Thanks for the intro — Alex from RedPen Security. Attached is our initial scope proposal (redpen-scope-proposal-v1.pdf). Before we lock dates I have a few logistics items to confirm so we can generate the engagement plan and SOW: 

- Confirm environment(s) to test: staging (recommended) vs prod (if allowed) and any partial-prod endpoints.
- Network access model: will we use a jumpbox (SSH), VPN, or IP allowlist for external perimeter testing? If jumpbox, do you provide creds or should we use our ephemeral cert-based method?
- Time windows & blackout periods (maintenance windows, deployment freezes).
- Point of contact on call during active testing and escalation path for critical findings.
- Evidence delivery preferences (upload to your GDrive folder vs encrypted S3).

We can work as blackbox / authenticated (credentialed) depending on the accounts you provide. If credentialed, please share test accounts with scope-limited privileges and a target list (IP ranges, hostnames, mobile endpoints).

Proposed high-level schedule: kickoff call May 25, testing May 26-28, draft report by June 4, final report by June 11. We need confirmation of the access window by Friday so we can reserve nodes.

I attached the initial scope PDF and a short checklist. Happy to hop on a 30-min call to iron out details.

Thanks,
Alex Reed
Senior Engagement Lead | RedPen Security
redpen-scope-proposal-v1.pdf (attached)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex@redpensecurity.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + initial questions for pen test engagement (scope proposal attached)

Alex — thanks for the clear list. A few clarifications from our side:

- Environments: staging only for active exploit attempts. We will provide a read-only mirror of production data (sanitized) for test purposes. No full production creds.
- Network access: we prefer a temporary jumpbox in our VPC; we will not share static production credentials by email. I will place jumpbox connection details and a one-time key in 1Password and share a link before the kickoff.
- Blackout windows: daily deploy freeze from 17:30-18:30 PST, please avoid runs overlapping that minute.
- POC on our side: Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.ai) will be on-call during tests; Vivek will be escalation for anything blocking production.

I attached a CSV with our public IP ranges and a short list of staging test accounts (network-ranges.csv, test-accounts.csv).

One compliance asks: we need to ensure your report TOC maps findings to SOC 2 categories (CC6/CC7) so our compliance team can ingest the results. Also add a clause in the SOW for a free retest window for verified high/critical fixes (we usually ask for one retest within 30 days).

Kickoff: I can do 30 minutes this Friday May 22 at 10:00am PT to finalize. If that works, please send calendar invite.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
network-ranges.csv (attached)
test-accounts.csv (attached)
From: Alex Reed <alex@redpensecurity.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + initial questions for pen test engagement (scope proposal attached)

Laura — appreciate the fast reply and scope notes. Two quick items: 

1) Given Marcus's availability we can compress the testing window to May 26-27 (2 full days) if that reduces impact. That still lets us cover the web app + mobile API + staging services you listed.
2) For the credentialed portion, can you confirm whether test accounts should have read-only DB access or elevated read-write? Our standard is read-only + application-level admin user (no DB write). Please confirm.

SOW: we'll add the SOC 2 mapping to the TOC and a retest clause (no charge for one targeted retest of validated critical/high items within 30 days). I'll attach a draft engagement agreement (engagement-agreement.docx) and a deliverables checklist.

If Friday 5/22 10am PT works, I'll send the calendar invite.

— Alex
engagement-agreement.docx (attached)
deliverables-checklist.xlsx (attached)
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex@redpensecurity.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + initial questions for pen test engagement (scope proposal attached)

Alex — quick clarification from engineering ops:

- All testing must be against the staging cluster only. We will provide application-level admin accounts (no DB writes). For any DB-lookups we can provide a read-only DB user that is rate-limited and scoped to staging schemas.
- Please do not run disruptive actions against external integrations (payment gateway, third-party analytics). Those are out of scope.
- Add a remediation retest SLA: we expect acknowledgment of any critical findings within 24 hours and a remediation verification slot within 7 business days; if remediation requires code changes that are on a release cadence, we will schedule a retest.

I will be on the kickoff and available via Slack @marcus_lin during testing.

Marcus Lin
Director, Engineering Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Reed <alex@redpensecurity.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: PenTest Ops <ops@redpensecurity.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: testing window May 26-27 + deliverables checklist

Laura / Marcus — confirming logistics based on the thread and today's kickoff:

- Testing window: May 26 08:00 PST -> May 27 18:00 PST (we will pause for your deploy freeze 17:30-18:30).
- Access method: temporary jumpbox (1Password link with one-time key will be used).
- Credentialed scope: application admin + read-only DB user (no writes) — confirmed.
- Exclusions: payment gateway, third-party analytics, and any external E2E integrations.
- Reporting: draft findings delivered June 4 (encrypted upload to your Drive link). Final report by June 11.

Checklist of items we still need from you before kickoff:
- 1Password share for jumpbox key (expiration 48 hours)
- List of internal POCs and Slack contacts (you provided Marcus)
- Confirmed list of hostnames/IPs — we will use network-ranges.csv you already uploaded

We will upload interim high/critical items as we find them to the Drive folder and ping Slack for urgent items.

See attached: deliverables-checklist.xlsx (we'll update it throughout).

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
Alex Reed
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex@redpensecurity.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-kickoff: remediation tracking & evidence delivery expectations

Alex / Team — thanks for the detailed checklist and for accommodating our constraints. A couple of reminders before you start: 

- Findings triage: please post any confirmed critical/high findings to the shared Drive and notify Marcus on Slack within 48 hours of discovery. We will assign triage owners immediately.
- Remediation timeline: provide a short remediation plan for each finding within 7 calendar days. For items that require code changes, include estimated release window and a proposed retest date.
- Retest: we will prioritize retests of critical findings; retest will be scheduled within 7 business days after a fix is staged.
- Evidence delivery: final encrypted PDF + supporting PoCs (screenshots, request logs) should be uploaded to the Drive folder above and also to the DocuSign-backed SOW link upon final report sign-off.

Please ensure the report maps each finding to a SOC 2 criteria (we called that out earlier) and provide suggested remediation steps with code-level pointers where appropriate.

If anything changes mid-test (scope or timing), loop me in immediately. Good luck and talk soon.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
